story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound 834 date sources and populate Eligibility Date for new enrollment before eligibility begins
Populate Assessment Date for current eligibility when Assessment Date changes

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: All Test Step Expected Result cells for id "TC_TS002_003" lack any quoted error, rejection, or absent-record result; for example step 13 Test Step Expected Result says "No new transaction effective date change is loaded in FACETS, no new eligibility-effective-date update is created from the repeated 2025-06-29 value, and the member remains on the pre-existing current eligibility state without an additional changed-date record."

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date and preserve relevant fields when only Assessment Date changes

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge failure

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS003_003 is "Edge", but its Expected Results do not describe an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Examples quoted: step 7 Test Step Expected Result: "The file is visible in TM and any system messages do not indicate a successful new business update driven by a changed Assessment Date because the Assessment Date did not change."; step 11 Test Step Expected Result: "The member remains present in Facets, but the query does not show a newly applied transaction effective date caused by this file because the Assessment Date in the file was unchanged."; step 12 Test Step Expected Result: "No new processed eligibility row is created from this boundary file to represent a changed transaction effective date; only the pre-existing eligibility history remains."

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for future eligibility field changes when Assessment Date is unchanged
Use Maintenance Date for current eligibility field changes when Assessment Date is unchanged
Confirm regression that Maintenance Date is not overused and downstream financial behavior remains unaffected
Use first date occurrence when multiple inbound dates are present
